image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured pink surface. The bib features a white central panel with blue and white striped trim around the edges and neck. It has an embroidered design in the center depicting a tiered cake or stack of items. The neck area shows ties made of the same striped fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidered cake/stack design lacks clear thread definition; it appears slightly smudged or 'painted on' rather than having distinct raised stitching, which is a common AI artifact in rendering fine textile details.
The tie on the top left appears to merge slightly into the background and itself, lacking a clean, distinct end point. The fabric folds look somewhat unnatural and fused.
